shorts_extract.hook: Think one small daily sugary snack is harmless as long as your weight stays flat? An 8-week brain-scan trial proved otherwise.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Thanarajah, Tittgemeyer & Small's 2023 Cell Metabolism 8-week pudding RCT + Hall's NIH +508 kcal/day trial + Kullmann's 2025 brain-insulin study.
shorts_extract.twist: Zero weight gain on the scale, yet fMRI caught rewired dopamine reward circuits AND lingering brain-insulin lag!
